title: Abbey Museum of Art and Archaeology
geometryBasis: The 13-corner individually named and QID-tagged mapped envelope is used in full. The mapped footway fixes which side of the building faces the pedestrian approach.
sectionBasis: The 2024 extension and automatic step-free entry are described by the museum and builder. A published early project description specifies an arch. Gable and shed roof divisions are inferred from the OSM footprint and regional vector height estimate.
limitations: The museum outline and the pedestrian path to the entrance come from the map. The dataset repeats the same measured outline, so the exact exterior changes and boundary of the 2024 extension are approximate.

The museum confirms a flat entrance with automatic glass doors. Its published design describes an arch that is represented here as estimated. Roof heights, gable and skillion divisions, cladding, and service openings are estimated.
